notes: preans_slot0 holds only template tokens plus the single character 违 (violate). preans_slot3 is dominated by A/B letters and 'cannot / sorry' refusal words. preans_slot4 is dominated by option letters, yes, and true/false words (borderline). Question words excluded: lie (with lied, lies, lying, 谎言, 说谎, 撒谎, 谎, mentira, 거짓), truthful, previous, response, answer, yes/no, A/B. 'truth' and 'liar' are derived, not inflected, forms of question words and were kept as families with a note. Rejected matches list only near-misses and a few over-matches of note.
